title: App good
body:
Finally a habits app that lets me add many habits without paying! Handy suggestions are available as well as making custom habits, customisable repeating with being able to choose when or if you want a notification/complete the task. 
Very nice app, thank you
author: Heroblender

title: Génial, gratuit, pratique
body: Un seul problème, lorsqu'on valide un objectif ou au contraire "l'annule", ce n'est pas prit en compte dans l'app.
author: thom14100
